policies.name: circuit-breaker
policies.reads: the node's recent success and failure outcomes
policies.decides: skips a node whose error rate reached 50% over at least 4 runs; lets one probe through after 2 s

policies.name: bulkhead
policies.reads: how many requests for the node are in flight
policies.decides: sheds (skips) a request once 6 are already in flight for that node

policies.name: confidence-gate
policies.reads: mobilenet's softmax confidence for this image
policies.decides: skips bert_tiny once mobilenet is at least 85% sure; there is nothing left to describe

policies.name: precision-planner
policies.reads: measured FP32 and INT8 p95 per node, and the job's budget
policies.decides: solves a 0/1 knapsack over the critical path for which nodes to run INT8 so the job fits

policies.name: latency-budget
policies.decides: drops a node to INT8 once less than 30 ms of the budget is left

policies.name: load-aware
policies.reads: the CPU and GPU_SIM queue depths
policies.decides: sends the node to whichever lane has the shallower queue
